brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create exactly one finished Japanese editorial basketball thumbnail for バスケまとめ, PNG, wide 16:9 composition, ideally 1792x1008 pixels or larger. Opaque background.

Style reference: the black and lime approved thumbnail viewed in this conversation (B-culver-black-lime-v3.png) is STYLE ONLY: dark charcoal #151A18, acid lime #CCF43B, ivory ink, forceful hand-drawn brush marks, bold readable Japanese typography, few elements, print-editorial energy. Do not reuse the sample's player, player name, statistics, dates, scores, pose or layout.

Subject and likeness: exactly ONE real professional basketball player: Tavrion Dawson (テイブリオン・ドーソン), from the official Tokushima Gambarous portrait that was viewed. Use the portrait only to guide drawn likeness, never paste photographic pixels. Preserve his short naturally coiled textured black afro with irregular tips, long oval face, high cheekbones, broad nose, slightly heavy-lidded eyes, moustache and short chin/goatee beard with relatively clean cheeks, dark skin and strong tall athletic build. Face must remain clearly legible, with ink highlights rather than a black silhouette. Draw him completely as a hand-inked illustration, not photorealistic.
Pose: on the LEFT 43% of the image, in a dynamic low forward drive, torso leaning diagonally, eyes looking toward play, knees bent. One hand controls an orange basketball alongside his hip, the other is bent naturally for balance. Full head, both hands and complete ball stay safely inside the canvas. Mid-thigh lower crop is intentional; no joint cutoffs or floating limbs. A simple unbranded light blue and ivory sleeveless basketball uniform, no words, no number, no team logo, no sponsor marks. Accurate hands and arm anatomy.
The player was randomly selected solely as an illustrative motif from a team named in the manuscript. This is not a depiction or claim of his actual appearance or performance in this game, and not an actual photographed game moment. No other people.

Composition: player anchors left, typography occupies right 55%, maintaining generous 4% outer safe margins, all lines fully visible. An energetic lime brush swoosh runs behind the figure but does not obstruct text or facial details. Plain subtle charcoal backdrop; no crowd, no scoreboards, no logo. Strong size hierarchy: huge lime date and ivory headline; two clean readable fixture rows; smaller but legible factual qualifier and footer. Avoid clutter and tiny illegible text.

Render ONLY these exact Japanese text lines, no extra lettering:
「バスケまとめ」
「11/17 試合予定」
「長崎 vs 三河」
「福岡 vs 徳島」

The two fixture names and the common scheduled 19:05 time are schedule information, NOT scores. The pending qualifier must be clearly readable. Do not add any player name, rankings, BEST5/TOP3, performance claim, result, point total or jersey text. Retain the AI illustration disclosure exactly. All article facts come only from the supplied frozen manuscript: at 2026-11-17 04:29 JST both fixtures are pregame, and official records await confirmation.

Edit this existing thumbnail once, changing ONLY framing / safe margins. Keep exactly the same hand-inked illustration, the same real player Tavrion Dawson likeness, the same pose, colors, brush texture, and every existing Japanese text character and number. Keep 16:9, at least 1672 pixels wide, PNG.
PROBLEM: the player's leftmost hand touches the left image boundary, hair nearly touches the top, headline nearly touches the right.
FIX: scale the entire existing designed content to 90% of its present size, centered within a slightly expanded matching dark charcoal #151A18 background, so there is a continuous safe margin of at least 45 pixels on all four edges. Reconstruct the tiny leftmost cropped edge of the player's hand naturally, keeping anatomically correct fingers. Do not crop hands, head, ball or text. The lower mid-thigh framing may remain intentional, with the figure naturally continuing to the bottom if needed. Preserve the text size hierarchy and layout, avoiding new visual elements. No names, scores, numbers on jersey, logos or photographic textures.
Text must stay exactly:
